Belvedere & Borrowdale, Harare

Look inside, gently. Treat with the smallest cut possible.

Specialist endoscopy and general surgery led by Dr E.G. Muguti. We find the cause of digestive and surgical problems with a camera, and treat them with keyhole techniques wherever we can, so recovery is quicker and scars are smaller.

Find the right care

Tell us where it hurts. We'll show you what can help.

Tap a part of the body, or choose from the list. You'll see what that part does, the reasons people usually come to see us, and the procedures Dr Muguti offers for it.

Your rightYour left

This guide helps you find information and the right appointment. It does not diagnose. If you are worried about a symptom, speak to us or your doctor.

Don't wait for an appointment if you have:

  • Vomiting blood, or vomit that looks like coffee grounds
  • Black, sticky stools or heavy bleeding from the back passage
  • Sudden, severe pain in the belly that won't settle
  • A swollen, hard belly with vomiting and no wind passing
  • A painful hernia lump that won't go back in
  • Yellow eyes or skin with fever and shivering

Go to your nearest hospital emergency department now, then call us on +263 772 560 415.

What we do

Two kinds of care, one specialist surgeon.

Endoscopy lets us see inside the gut without cutting. When surgery is needed, Dr Muguti uses laparoscopic (keyhole) methods wherever they suit you.

Endoscopy

See the problem clearly

Minimally invasive. Usually home the same day.

  • Gastroscopy upper gut
  • Colonoscopy large bowel
  • Diagnostic endoscopy find the cause
  • Therapeutic endoscopy treat inside
  • Biopsy tissue sample
  • Polypectomy polyp removal
  • Gut bleeding care GI bleeding
  • Screening & surveillance ulcers, cancer
  • Feeding tube placement gastrostomy
  • Laryngology clinic throat, voice box

General surgery

Treat it with care

Expert hands. Keyhole where possible.

  • Gallbladder removal cholecystectomy
  • Hernia repair groin, navel
  • Appendix removal appendectomy
  • Reflux surgery GERD
  • Breast surgery lumps, cancer
  • Bowel surgery colorectal
  • Haemorrhoid treatment piles
  • Thyroid surgery thyroidectomy
  • Varicose veins circulation
  • Lumps & bumps cysts, growths
  • Pancreas & liver surgery by referral
  • Weight-loss surgery bariatric

Procedure guides

Know exactly what will happen, before you arrive.

Fear mostly comes from not knowing. Each guide walks you through the day in plain language.

Preparation planner

Your own preparation timetable, worked out to the hour.

Choose your procedure and appointment time. We'll turn the standard instructions into real dates and times you can send to your phone.

Procedure

Your visit

From first message to follow-up.

  1. Request

    Send a booking request on WhatsApp or by phone. A referral letter helps but you can also book directly.

  2. Consultation

    Dr Muguti listens, examines you and explains your options before anything is booked.

  3. Preparation

    You receive written instructions and your preparation timetable.

  4. Procedure day

    Arrive early with an adult to take you home. We check consent and answer last questions.

  5. Recovery

    You rest while the team monitors you, then hear what was found in plain words.

  6. Follow-up

    Biopsy results and next steps are discussed with you, and shared with your referring doctor.

Why there are no patient reviews here. Zimbabwe's medical council rules do not allow doctors to advertise with patient testimonials. Instead, we show you exactly what to expect, so you can judge for yourself.

Your surgeon

Dr Edwin G. Muguti

Specialist Consultant Surgeon & Endoscopist

Dr Muguti is a general surgeon with specialist training in endoscopy and laparoscopic surgery. He sees every patient himself, from the first consultation to the follow-up visit, and works with referring doctors across Zimbabwe.

Space for his story: years in practice, hospitals where he has worked or teaches, special interests, and why he started the Suite.

The suite

A dedicated endoscopy suite inside a working medical centre.

The Belvedere suite sits within the Centre for Diabetes Management, which also has a pharmacy, laboratory and dialysis unit on site.

Patient monitoring

Heart rate, oxygen and blood pressure are watched throughout your procedure.

Comfort first

Throat spray or sedation is offered so most people feel little or nothing.

Lab next door

Blood tests and samples are handled on site, which saves you a trip.

Clear results

You hear what was found before you leave, in plain language.

For referring doctors

Refer a patient in under two minutes.

GPs and specialists across Zimbabwe refer patients to Dr Muguti for endoscopy and surgery. We report back to you after every procedure.

Send a referral on WhatsApp
  1. Send the referralWhatsApp or email a referral letter with the patient's name, phone number, the procedure you're asking for and how urgent it is.
  2. We contact the patientThe team books the patient, sends preparation instructions and checks medical aid details.
  3. You get the reportFindings, photos where useful, and histology results are sent back to you, with a clear plan.
